title: openstack-glance-operator-kog values
description: Values for the OpenStack Glance KOG (Krateo Operator Generator) chart. It emits per-resource RestDefinitions for Glance image v2 resources and a stateless Keystone-auth bridge proxy. Toggle resources and point the auth-bridge at your Glance/Keystone deployment.

restdefinitions.description: Per-resource RestDefinitions emitted by this chart. Each entry can be toggled on/off and carries its resourceGroup and resourceKind.

image.description: Glance Image (metadata) resource: create / get / delete. Glance v2 is flat JSON so the Kind is unprefixed. No update verb (Glance update is JSON-Patch only).

enabled.description: Emit the RestDefinition for the Image resource.

resourceGroup.description: API group for the generated Image CRD.

resourceKind.description: Kind of the generated Image CRD.

imageimport.description: Glance ImageImport (web-download) resource: a single-fire action that populates a queued image from a URL, making it ACTIVE.

enabled.description: Emit the RestDefinition for the ImageImport resource.

resourceGroup.description: API group for the generated ImageImport CRD.

resourceKind.description: Kind of the generated ImageImport CRD.

imagemember.description: Glance ImageMember resource: share / get / unshare an image with another project.

enabled.description: Emit the RestDefinition for the ImageMember resource.

resourceGroup.description: API group for the generated ImageMember CRD.

resourceKind.description: Kind of the generated ImageMember CRD.

authBridge.description: Stateless Keystone-auth reverse proxy (openstacksdk). Authenticates with clouds.yaml, discovers the Glance image endpoint, injects a fresh auto-refreshing X-Auth-Token and forwards the controller's plain-HTTP calls upstream.

cloudsSecret.description: Name of the Secret holding clouds.yaml (key clouds.yaml). Create it with: kubectl create secret generic glance-clouds --from-file=clouds.yaml=clouds.yaml.

osCloud.description: Cloud name in clouds.yaml to authenticate as (OS_CLOUD).

serviceType.description: Keystone catalog service type to discover the endpoint for (SERVICE_TYPE). For Glance this is 'image'.

osInterface.description: Keystone catalog interface to use when discovering the endpoint (OS_INTERFACE), e.g. internal, public or admin.

upstreamEndpoint.description: THE key user input: the upstream Glance image endpoint. Leave empty to let openstacksdk discover it from the Keystone catalog, or override it explicitly, e.g. http://glance-api.openstack.svc.cluster.local:9292.

image.description: Container image for the auth-bridge proxy.

service.description: Service exposing the auth-bridge proxy in-cluster.

port.description: Service port the proxy listens on.

resources.description: Compute resource requests and limits for the auth-bridge proxy container.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the auth-bridge pod.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for the auth-bridge pod.

affinity.description: Affinity rules for the auth-bridge pod.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount to use. If empty and create is true, a name is generated.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified app name used in resource names.
